title: Mixed Event — In This Singing City

meta.Outline: With days to go before Leo/need's solo show, Shiho is on Vivid Street for an errand. When a powerful voice coming from an alley blows her away, she follows the sound to find An alone, singing intensely.

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I think I'll be on my way now.
If you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Sure, and thanks for your hard work today.
Say, isn't your solo show coming up? How's the prep going?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're doing everything we can to be ready. The closer we get to the day of, the more focused we feel.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's like... We give each other energy just by picking up our instruments together.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
I see. That's exciting to hear.
Are you off to practice now?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Actually, no. My amp started acting up yesterday, so I'm taking it to be fixed.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Really?
In that case, you can use this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Is this...a coupon?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: That's right. Do you know Vivid Street?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: My brother opened up an instrument shop just off it. Why don't you check it out?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you very much for the suggestion. If you're sure it's alright, I'll accept this coupon.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: No problem. And good luck!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to Leo/need's solo show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you. We'll be sure to make it a great show.
A few hours later
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm going to save a bunch on repairs now...
I have to thank my boss next time I see him.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Not to mention all those rare models they had. It was cool getting to try them all out.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But none of them compared to my own bass. I've used it for so long that my fingers are just...used to it.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(...
I kinda want to play it now. My amp's in the shop, though, so... I think I'll go over to SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (What's that singing?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(They're so good...
I think it's coming from this way.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, we're Vivid BAD SQUAD!
How are you all doing?! Are you guys having fun?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes... It's Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I've got goosebumps. Her voice is so overwhelming...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And... My heart aches just listening to her.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I already knew she had a powerful voice from when I saw her at Shibuya Festa. But she's gotten even better now...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
No surprises there.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (If I remember right, she's trying to surpass a legendary event called RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And she must be serious if she can sing this passionately... So passionately my heart aches.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That's right. We'll also...)
The next day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Everyone's in good form.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But, I keep thinking about yesterday...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(That overpowering voice...
That was incredible.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I want to try performing with that kind of power. I bet it could really profoundly resonate with people...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I know. I can...heavily accent my strumming to produce a sort of clean, staccato sound...!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow, that was really good just now.
It was like the bass picked up and pulled everything together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're on a whole new level, including their playing itself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Keep it up till the end!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Nod*
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's all eight songs covered! Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I have to say, you've all built up stamina and improved your performance skills.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I suppose practice is paying off.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But hey! Shih was extra incredible today, right?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're right. She was producing an even cleaner sound than usual, and playing with extra feeling.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Did something good happen?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not exactly... But something like that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's this friend of a friend, and I got to hear her sing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And when I did, it was like I was charged up, or like I had a fire lit under me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow... For you to be that impressed, this person must really be incredible.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you probably know her, Ichika. She's Kohane's teammate, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait, Shiraishi?
So that's who it was...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiraishi is definitely talented. I learned a lot from her when she taught me about singing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow... I think I'd like to hear this Shiraishi person's singing too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I hear she and her team are putting on their own events lately. If you're interested, wanna check one out together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really? I'd love the chance to go and listen.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Got it. In that case, I'll ask Kohane next time I see her.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Kohane's helping us out so much with the flyers for the solo show, so it'd be great to all go support them!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Actually, everyone. Can we talk for a second about those flyers?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It turns out Kohane has some samples of the solo show flyer ready for us to look at.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! She already got that far with the design we asked her to make?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and I'd like to get the final product printed soon since there isn't much time left before the show. I had planned to go collect the samples this Saturday, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Did something come up?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be going on a family outing... I don't think I can go collect them that day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, it would be a big help if someone could go instead of me to collect them. Are any of you free?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saturday... Okay, how about I go?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. My shift ends early that day, and I think I can go on the way home.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see... Thank you, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, where do I need to go?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, it's a place on Vivid Street called...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Weekend Garage...
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wow, so this is Vivid Street.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<It's an interesting place, huh.
So full of singers and music.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. There are a lot of musicians active in this area.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even Shiraishi's place we're headed to is well-known for its live music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I heard she herself sings there sometimes. It'd be great if we could hear her sing today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe, I agree.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You and Ichika had so much to say about this girl that I got really curious about her, so I'd be happy just to see her.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Thanks for bringing me along, Shiho.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's see now, we turn here and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh. I think that's the place.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's go. Be careful not to be seen, okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Got it.>
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Welcome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hello. I'm supposed to be meeting Kohane. Is she here?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! The flyers, right? Wait just a second!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane! Hinomori's here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry for having you come all this way, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't mention it. Actually, we're the ones who asked you the favor, so I should be apologizing to you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Either way, we don't get many Miya Girls students among our customers. I'm glad you're here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, you two feel free to use that table over there!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Over here, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're the girl from the School Festival...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're the guy who was scared of the zombie wolf.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?! Who said I was scared? I was just surprised.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was a realistic zombie wolf after all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But... I see.
So the girl Azusawa was waiting for was you, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes! Actually Shiho, we all watched your band perform at Shibuya Festa. Your performance was really cool and exciting!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks. We were pretty satisfied with our performance that day ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And you were all amazing too. I liked how you sang with so much power.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehehe, that's good to hear!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Though, we all still need to put in the work!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Shiraishi. Weren't you singing out there on the street the other night?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't want to disturb you since you seemed to be concentrating... But you were singing with so much power. Like, enough to make my heart ache.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: To make your heart ache?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ah... I guess that was when I stayed back after practice. I was pretty in the zone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'd been wanting to sing with more emotion, so I was practicing that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...
I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, I get how you sometimes just feel the urge like that. But don't overdo it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, I know that. You worry too much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...
But yeah, thank you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, our last event was a big success thanks to Kohane, and we need to bring even more energy next time!

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line: Hey, An's all fired up!

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line:
Now I wanna hear you sing.
Can you do just one song?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... Sure! I suppose I can spare you one song!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: On that note, sorry Hinomori! Please give your order to my dad.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Got it. Break a leg.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(What was with Shiraishi just now...?
She seemed a little off.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Did I say something I shouldn't have?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh yeah, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I left the flyer samples in the back, so I'll go get them now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Got it. Thanks again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No problem! It looks like An's going to sing now, so why don't you listen while you wait?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, looks like the mic's on!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Who'd have guessed Shiraishi really would sing for us?
Miku's gonna get to hear her after all.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Miku, it looks like Shiraishi's going to sing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So it does. I think I'll listen in.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, here I go!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Wow, this girl's just like Shiho said. Her singing is so cool and powerful.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And I think I can see how Ichika had so much to learn from her.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Street music has a totally different kind of power from rock... This feels so new and exciting.)

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line: Way to go, An!

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line: One more song!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The customers are so into it. I can tell how much they love her singing... There's a great atmosphere here.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's not quite the same as that time.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I don't feel the same power that made my heart ache...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <She's just like you said, Shiho. She's cool and sings really well.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Shiho...?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, uh... It's nothing.
I just—

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting!
Here are the flyer samples!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, great. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I drew up a few different samples based on my discussion with Honami. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow, the overall feel changes a lot with just a tweak to the balance of the text. Which should we go for...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huff...
Okay, it's time to wrap it up!

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line:
Thanks An!
You really got some pipes on you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe, that's sweet of you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's not enough... At this level, I'm still so far behind. I need to practice more.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Since you want to be someone she can “respect and be proud of”, An, you want her to like and be excited by the way you sing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're worried about not being able to do that if Kohane keeps improving at her current rate, right...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I need to practice more, to sing more. Right now, that's...all I can do...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See you later, Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: See you. And Kohane, thanks for all your help.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course! I'm glad to be of help. Good luck with your solo show!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It looks like the flyers will turn out well thanks to Kohane. And on top of that, I got to hear Shiraishi sing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Shiho, what's up?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You had something on your mind when you were watching Shiraishi before, right?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Her singing just now was incredible, but it was pretty different from when I heard it the other night.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Different? In what way?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Last time, her singing was so powerful that my heart ached. But I didn't really get that from her today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
She was singing so well...
So, why do I feel this way...?
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is it that time already? I'd better get going.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hm? A message...
It's from Mom.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's see... She wants me to stop by the store?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She must've forgotten to get something for dinner. Oh well, what're you gonna do...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, I don't have any other errands, so I can get this done quickly and go home.
Supermarket

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hmm... We use a mild curry roux, right? I think I recognize this package.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now for the honey... Where would that be?

Ooh, these look so fresh...
They're not the cheapest, but I think I'll pick these.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Hm? Is that...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, it is you, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh, Hinomori?! Who would've thought I'd run into you here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Are you buying things for your dinner?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. My mom asked me to.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, then we're in the same boat. I'm here because my dad asked me to help restock.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Restock?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yup!
You know—peanuts, sugar, sandwich fillings—stuff like that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We usually order them wholesale, but we happened to run out today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This place always delivers on quality and the range of options, so it's our safety net when we run out of stock.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There are plenty of options alright. They're so plentiful that I've been getting lost trying to find anything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What are you looking for?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um... Honey, miso and...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, those'll be on the shelves at the back, I think.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This way! Follow me!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Uh, okay.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Phew...
That's everything. Thanks a lot, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But also, sorry. I know you're busy helping your dad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't worry about it! He told me I can take my time as long as I'm back before the bar opens.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? If you say so, then...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Weekend Garage is a really nice place. I think I get why people like it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your customers are a nice crowd, and you have a really good audio setup.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hahaha, that's Dad's high standards for you.
Also, I didn't realize you know a lot about sound equipment.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, I work at a live house, so I'm around it all the time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see! I don't really know much about that stuff. I'm a singing specialist!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
“Singing specialist”? What's that supposed to mean?
Well, you are a really great singer in any case.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Oh yeah. Singing...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Why was she singing so differently the two times I heard her?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Why, when the first time she was so incredibly powerful that my heart ached?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Could it be that something unusual had happened the first time? If so, what could bring on something that intense?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Maybe I'll ask her...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hm?
Hey, look at that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh, what?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Look, there's an event going on!
It says it's a “Flower Viewing Goldfish Exhibit”!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A Flower Viewing Goldfish Exhibit? I didn't know that was a thing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Admire the cherry blossoms and goldfish on display with the theme of flower viewing picnics.” Apparently, it's an installation set up by that aquarium near the station.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... This looks like it could be interesting!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey! It's even free. Do you wanna check it out for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh, like together?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I bet it'll be more fun than going alone.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I guess a quick visit won't hurt. Mom's not in that big of a hurry.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. Let's go then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Woohoo! Off we go!
Flower Viewing Goldfish Exhibit

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa, so this is what it's like! It's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I associate aquariums with dim lighting, but it's pretty bright in here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. And there's a nice smell. It's...cherry blossom?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're right. Now that I smell that, it really feels like a flower viewing picnic.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know what you mean! I was just thinking how nice it feels.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And there are all these types of goldfish.
Hey, let's take a look at that big tank in the middle!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
Wow. I wonder how many fish are in here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This tank has a lot of different ones too. Some of them even have cool patterns!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Hinomori! Those fish there, look at them!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “Those fish” doesn't exactly narrow it down... I wouldn't know one goldfish from another.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whaaat? Look, those two being all buddy-buddy! Aren't they cute with their big round eyes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Buddy-buddy...? Oh, those two?
Yeah, now that you mention it, they are cute.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. It's sweet how they're so inseparable. Do you think they're a mom and her kid? Or maybe two friends?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't know... But they do look sweet.
Oh. Shiraishi, is that you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It is you. I didn't realize you were here too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um... Is this your friend?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes! We bumped into each other at the supermarket.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I recognize her. I think she was in that group photo Honami took at the kindergarten.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Wasn't she the person who taught Honami to draw?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: My name is Shiho Hinomori. Pleased to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You...wouldn't be Shizuku's sister, would you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?
Flower Viewing Goldfish Exhibit

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um... Yes, Shizuku Hinomori is my sister...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ah, I was right! Hey, do you know Airi Momoi?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Y-Yes. She's in my sister's group...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes! I've known Airi since we were in middle school together. I met Shizuku through her, and we hang out sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ah, I see. So you're a friend of Shizuku's, um...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Ena Shinonome. Nice to meet you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The pleasure's mine, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, does the two of you being here mean that you like this kind of exhibit?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, not exactly. We were just curious and stopped by...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, it's not a combination you see every day, right? Cherry blossoms and goldfish.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, exactly!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hahaha, you have a point. I feel like I only see goldfish at festivals.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Are you interested in goldfish and aquariums, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um, not really... I'm here today to work on my art.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: On your...art?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I draw a lot, but I'm trying to become better at it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But, why goldfish? Drawing something that's moving sounds really hard...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hahaha, you're right. Not only fish, but the flow of water is also difficult to depict.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm hoping to capture the way the goldfish leave ripples and bubbles in the water as they swim.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see... That does sound very hard.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wouldn't have the first clue how to capture the flow of water.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hahaha, it's definitely not easy.
There's also the fact that I thought the cherry blossoms would look nice, though.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I know what you mean there! I bet they'll make for such a classy picture next to those cute goldfish.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Exactly! Speaking of which, I think I'm gonna get sketching.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, why don't we check out the displays over there?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sounds good!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Good luck, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I hope you guys enjoy yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you. Well, if you'll excuse us.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, let's get down to it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But, which of these little guys should I pick as a model? One with pretty scales...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Actually, Shiraishi said something earlier...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. It's sweet how they're so inseparable. Do you think they're a mom and her kid? Or maybe two friends?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Didn't she say that two of them were inseparable?
Oh, these two?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm, that's nice. I feel warm inside just watching them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The idea of quietly spending all your time with someone you want to be with...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I want to draw these guys.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's not just the goldfish. The cherry blossoms they have displayed next to them are also pretty.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was just thinking that! I associate goldfish with summer, but even now in the spring, they're happily swimming along.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, seasons don't really matter for that, right? They're alive all year round.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa, it says here the one in this tank is twenty years old.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're right! It's so cool to think something this tiny has lived longer than us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I think we've seen everything now. Though we didn't look at the big tank in the middle much...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Oh, it's Shinonome. She's been sketching there the whole time.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She's so serious...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (No, not just serious...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This isn't right. It should be more...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She looks...pained.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ena's so focused.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She looks so distressed, so...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What kind of art is she making...?
Flower Viewing Goldfish Exhibit

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There... I'm done.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But... It's still not good enough.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (There's no sense of depth between these two and the fish in the background. And the perspective is a little off...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The shadows are...mediocre. I didn't attempt anything complex, like capturing the light bouncing off the tank.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But, I at least had some success depicting the water being pushed by their fins.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It's still not enough, but...
It's an improvement... I think.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ena! How did it go?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, it's you two. How was the exhibit?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We just finished a lap of the whole floor! Every goldfish was so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I see. That's nice to hear.
I also just finished my sketch.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You must be tired since you were focusing so hard on it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hahaha, maybe I was. I guess I produced what you'd expect from someone at my level...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Ena! If you don't mind, could we see your sketch?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Yes, that's fine.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here you go.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, this is amazing! These are those goldfish that were swimming close to each other, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The water looks so real. You can tell how slowly and gently they're swimming.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, you even captured that bit of warmth they have.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Warmth...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, well... Um, it's just that I thought those two seemed really friendly when I was looking at them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was nice to see, and I felt the same thing when I saw this picture.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I know what you mean! It's like you can feel so much kindness from these two, as if they're happy to be together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I see... Thank you, both of you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This sketch isn't good enough, and it's full of problems.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But the thing I wanted to capture...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The sense of gentleness and kindness I got from those two inseparable fish... They understood that from my art.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm going to keep working hard.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: From where I'm standing, you seem incredible already. You're so hardworking and dedicated, Ena.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're kinda like Akito in that way.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As in, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Oops, did I not say? Ena is Akito's older sister.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't know...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not sure how much I'm like Akito...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I do take my art seriously. I wouldn't exactly call them “goals”, but there are some things I'm hoping to achieve lately.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Things you're hoping to achieve?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes. The thing is, I'm in charge of creating art for a music group.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um... To put it simply, I draw or paint pictures to match the tracks that my groupmates make, and then our music videos are based on those.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, that sounds hard... I've heard this already, but I can't get over how amazing it is!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wouldn't call myself amazing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Actually, for a while now I've had the feeling that I can't keep up with the group's music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My groupmates have always been incredible creators, but lately they've been reaching new heights.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And so, I want to be able to express their work with my art.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: With my art, I want to be able to tell the story within each song they make.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (With her art...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, the only thing for it is to keep practicing and improving.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Oh. So, her pained, intense expression... That was all for her friends.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Because she wants to improve what she creates with them.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(...
I should put in the effort too.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's...the only thing for it.
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well then, I think I'm going to do some shopping and then head home.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It was a little embarrassing, but thank you for letting me talk about that stuff today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't mention it. I was happy to get to hear it. It was sorta motivating actually.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It encouraged me too. I feel pushed to give better performances with my band.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? That's good to hear, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, I'll be off. Get home safe, both of you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you. Shiraishi, let's head this way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm glad I got to talk to Shinonome yesterday. I want to do the same...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I want to take music seriously. Even more than I do already...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Shiho sounds really good again... I'm getting super excited!
It's like her feelings are being carried by the music!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Shiho really is amazing. She just keeps getting better and better...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We need to try and keep up...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can count on everyone's performances.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Even if I push forward, Ichika and the others will always end up beside me.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (In that case, I've gotta make sure they can follow me further than we've ever gone...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We were really good just now! Ichika was so cool during the chorus...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks. Shiho was producing a really incredible sound, so I guess I...followed her.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you mean! She had me going all out to get on her level!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's just what I thought, then. I knew you guys felt that way based on how you were playing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well then, let's ride this wave and go one more time.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nice work, guys.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We really went for it today! Hey, do you guys wanna stop at the cafe for a while?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds good. I'd like that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can't, sorry. I need to go collect the amp I took in for repairs.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Yes, it was due for collection today, wasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case, how about the three of us go today?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. I'll join you guys another time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, we'll make sure to thoroughly check the menu for anything new you might like!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure thing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright then. I guess I'll get going.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh yeah.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (If I'm going there anyway, I can let Miku know.)
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Thanks for bringing me along again, Shiho.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't mention it. I was coming here anyway for my amp.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And you seemed to really like this street.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah. It really is an interesting place.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <With so many people performing, it's as if the city itself is singing their love of music.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I agree. Though, this area is a little out of the way, and I don't see anyone performing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, but I can hear someone singing over there.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh yeah. But, that voice...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It is her...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The way she's singing is totally different from when we heard her at Weekend Garage.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's singing with so much force it's heart-rending... Just like when I heard her the other night on this street.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Heart-rending...?
I see what you mean. She's putting her heart and soul into it.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It sort of reminds me of Ichika and the others during those intense training sessions.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We all know that it isn't going to be easy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Even so...
I want to make that happen before our show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It's as if Shiraishi is trying to catch up to someone with her singing, like the others tried to catch up to you.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shiraishi is just like the others were that time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Even today... They performed with so much intensity.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Shiraishi has something just like the strength I felt that time...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Time for a quick break, I think.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Where's my drink...? Oh, I'm all out.
I better go buy something.
Do you want this?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Hinomori? What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I had an errand at an instrument shop around here, and now I'm on my way home.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I haven't opened this yet, so please take it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I bought it, but never got around to drinking it. Call it my treat.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha. Well then, don't mind if I do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Back to life! Thanks, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your singing was amazing just now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to put it... You just sang really well, with so much feeling.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha... Really? I mean, I wouldn't say it was that good...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I mean it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I remembered the others when I heard you sing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... As in, Ichika and everyone?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm not sure how to put it, but your singing...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your singing was so powerful. Like the feeling of desperately wanting to be around someone. Like thinking about someone dear to you and...following them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh... Sorry for suddenly rambling on like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's fine. But what made you think that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, uh... It's my band, you see.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The thing is, I'm the most experienced member.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't realize. But now that you mention it, I did think your bass playing was really advanced when I saw you guys perform.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Nod*
And until recently, I was holding myself back to match the others' level...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But lately, something has changed with them...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The others told me to stop holding back, and that they'll catch up to my level eventually. After that, I took a good look at myself and started to play with all I have.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: At the time, they all had this really intense look in their eyes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And when you were singing just now, you had a look just like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, you hit the nail on the head.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm also...
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My dad used to be a musician in this town.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah, I've heard. He's famous, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, exactly! And about three years ago, he put on this event called RAD WEEKEND with fellow musicians in this town.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's that event that's supposed to have been legendary...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. It really was electric. It was as if everyone in the venue came together with the same energy, like no one could help but sing and shout along.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ever since that event, I've dreamed of surpassing it... And that's what me and my teammates are working toward.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Recently, we even started getting together with other musicians to hold our own events. Just the other day we pulled off an amazing one!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They're all really good at what they do. Akito relentlessly pushes us to keep getting better... Toya is an incredible songwriter...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And Kohane... Ever since we met, I've been proud to be her partner! Her singing always gets me pumped.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I was surprised when I saw her sing at Shibuya Festa. She seemed so different from her usual self.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's not like she's already been singing for years, so it's crazy, right? She's growing too fast for me to even stop and admire her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane's honestly...too incredible. At our last event, she...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The point is, I need to get my head in the game!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I got a little frenzied. I've been using any spare time I have to practice like today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want to surpass RAD WEEKEND no matter what it takes. But I'm not chasing that dream alone anymore.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want to realize that dream with Kohane—with all of them—singing by my side.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Frenzied...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Even with as much singing talent as she has, Shiraishi still thinks like that.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Shiraishi's driven by such a powerful, intense feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's driving her to give the best performance she can with the people closest to her...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: By the time the day of our show rolls around, we'll be standing shoulder-to-shoulder with you...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, we can run across the finish line hand in hand, like that race we did way back when!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want to realize that dream with Kohane—with all of them—singing by my side.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I feel just the same as her.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I...understand. I know what it's like to chase a dream with the people you love.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In my case, I want to go pro with the others.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have friends who are determined to follow me and keep making music together. I'm able to keep trying thanks to them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because I have them, I think I'm... We're closer to our dream of going pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Their passion and their music keep me going.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And the same goes for you, Shiraishi... I think the way you're feeling is important.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure your feelings will become a kind of fuel to take your team higher.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My...feelings will...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. I think so.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...
I hope you're right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, Shiraishi. Do you wanna hear a song that we'll be playing at our solo show?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Where did that come from so suddenly?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The way you sang earlier really resonated with me. And I don't like not paying people back.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? That's a weird reason.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But, okay then. I'd like to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'll play Saki's song. I always make sure to have the backing track we made for practice.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (As long as I have this, even when I practice by myself, I'm never alone. The others are there to take my performance higher.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Looks like my amp's good as new.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I'll get started then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Hinomori's putting such intense emotion into this. She's playing with so much definition and clarity... She's so good.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She takes music seriously. She's passionate enough to confidently devote her life to this. And she doesn't hesitate for a second.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Hinomori's so cool.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you, Hinomori. I'm feeling kinda energized after that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? That's great.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, would you be interested in performing one more song, together this time?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Together... Like a session?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! It's only natural to want to perform with someone so cool! What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nice. I've been wanting to perform with you too, so I'm down.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! Yay!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In that case, how about this song...
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well then, let's do it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Flying right out the gates...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's like she's telling me to hurry up and join in. How should I do that?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'll start like this...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(...!
This really is such a good sound!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Shiraishi's singing sounds nicer than it did earlier. She's drawing out the notes and echoing into the distance.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It doesn't have that heart-rending feeling. She sounds like she's having so much fun...and I think I'm getting that same energy myself.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I've gotta match singing like this...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Oh... Hinomori's playing just changed a little.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's a really clean sound, just like before. And she has this unique groove. I'm hooked.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She really sounds like she's having fun, too. I can hear her getting more and more into it.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But she's not having all the fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Shiraishi... So she can sing like this too. Nice.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Next, let's...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I cannot sing...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No... That doesn't sound right.
I want to get closer to the Cowardly Canary...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I need to get closer...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm a little scared of this street, so I came to try and empathize with the Cowardly Canary's fear of the forest...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I don't think this will be enough to get into character...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I've gotta find a different way to practice. Once I have a good method, if I just keep at it...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But... Will that really...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Hm? Someone's singing?
Oh, is that...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Shiraishi and...Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I didn't know they could perform that well.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If I really want to close the gap, I need to give it all I have. Or else, I'll never get there...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That was so much fun! We ended up doing a whole bunch of songs!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You threw in these really good phrases at just the right parts, so I got more and more into it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe, so did I. And you sang really well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You sing with so much power, Shiraishi. I brought out all the techniques I know just now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! You had me electrified with that sound! What was that?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I copied that playing style from a certain musician a while back, just for the heck of it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't normally use it, so it was a good opportunity to try it out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Speaking of which, didn't you also change up the rhythm suddenly?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? I guess I just felt like it. It's no surprise since you did something new with the bass every time I mixed it up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But thanks to all that, we had a real good time!
Um, excuse me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, what brings you to this neck of the woods? What a pleasant surprise!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... I was out for a walk, and then I heard you two...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, really? We weren't being too loud, were we? We were really getting into it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, it's nothing like that. But...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Would it be okay if...I sang with you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure, let's have a session together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's start.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They really are amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's like Hinomori's bass is pushing us forward.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I hesitate in the slightest, my voice gets drowned out by Shiraishi's. I need to project more...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, I feel so refreshed now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Me too...
I kinda feel braver than before.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Thank you for letting me join.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Don't mention it, Kusanagi!
I had fun singing with you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you sang really well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, I think it's about time we wrapped up. Thanks for doing this with me, you two!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And Hinomori, thank you for everything else today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. Do you two wanna come to our solo show?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: M-Me as well?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's okay. I'll get tickets for both of you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you! That's so nice.
I'm excited now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... Thank you, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And, good luck with the show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We promise to make it one worth looking forward to.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That was a really good session, wasn't it?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, Miku. You were listening to us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I was, yes. I'm guessing it was a good chance to relax for you, Shiho?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... I'm glad we got to perform together. I feel energized in the run-up to the real thing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Miku, I... I'm glad that I'm a musician.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Why do you say that?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's because I continued with music that I was able to come this far with the others. And I wouldn't have been able to perform like I did today if I hadn't.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe, I guess so.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I think you have the potential to grow even more, Shiho.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And the same goes for them.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm going to keep delivering the best performances with the others. And...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Whether it's during practice, at the solo show or somewhere we haven't even reached yet...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I never want to stop playing my bass with them.)
